scope: Selected visible white shoulder, FRONT ivory shield and LEFT ivory hood rim constraints for editable appearance reconstruction. Hidden closure/depth remains inferred; no physical or appearance acceptance.
pixel_coordinates: Original 1280x1280 JPG; u right, v down. FRONT and LEFT points retain their own uncalibrated panel coordinates.

observed_background_or_dark_mechanism_ou.comment: Only visible white guard boundary. First point meets outer-blue occlusion; lower points reach the exposed sloping tip. No hidden circular continuation is supplied.

observed_outer_blue_occlusion_edge.comment: Blue armor covers the underlying white guard here. This is the boundary of the visible region, not the unseen white shell silhouette.

visible_front_face_to_inner_bevel_direct.comment: Broad-face and inner side-face transition read from surface shading; lower confidence than the silhouette, not a fine engraved seam or depth measurement.

matching_frozen_C9.method: C9 control vertices projected by its ORTHO FRONT camera at H2.65/516 visual scale.
matching_frozen_C9.warning: Unoccluded mesh bounds, not an appearance pass; original camera and posture uncalibrated.

do_not_infer: Hidden white guard continuation behind blue cover.
Manufactured guard thickness or shoulder joint origin.
A fully known white shoulder shell from these visible arcs.

hood_left_side_lip.inner_status: Visible side rim/window read from white-blue boundaries; portions under blue shoulder/white arm remain candidate continuation.
hood_left_side_lip.construction_scope: A narrow real thin armor surface around the shoulder opening, not a filled ivory torso or black side wall. Laterally interpolated FRONT/REAR widths are candidate geometry, not measured physical depths.

front_white_shield_visible_boundary.method: Read-only original RGB/visible transition inspection. Boundaries follow blue/dark outline to ivory transition; they supersede the coarse front chest outline where the shoulder notch was lost.
front_white_shield_visible_boundary.lower_closure_status: Unobserved subpixel return at the dark lower lip. No bright white surface extends to v262-263; white hip connectors excluded.
front_white_shield_visible_boundary.hidden_depth_status: Front lateral visibility constraints only; not measured armor thickness, shoulder origin or calibrated depth.

front_main_shield.depth_status: Separate central FRONT plane candidate inside the LEFT forward envelope. Anchor X values use the prior LEFT envelope at v128/263; intermediate center depths are unmeasured reconstruction choices, not calibrated measurements.
front_main_shield.crease_status: Observed shallow main face turn at v123-128; long face edges denote broad surface turns, not necessarily engraved seams.

white_shoulder_left_visible_relation.relationship: Blue guard covers the white arc lower/rear portion; dark bearing sits behind both. These are visibility constraints, not a complete closed white guard outline.
white_shoulder_left_visible_relation.hidden_closure_status: Unobserved reconstruction candidates currently used in the generic ring depth. They are not measured contour points and cannot alone define the complete broad-face depth.
white_shoulder_left_visible_relation.C12_remaining_failure: FRONT broad/inner face guide is now used, but SIDE pointed cap and broad coverage mismatch remain. Replace the generic joint-guard surface construction in the following total-shape cycle.
